message.content: Rewrite the backoff calculation to be exponential with jitter.

content.text:
Switched `delay_for` to exponential backoff capped at 30 seconds, with a jitter factor so retries do not synchronise. That is committed on `fix/exponential-backoff`.

I also started a `retry_budget` helper but stopped at a decision I could not make for you: whether the budget is per call or across the whole retry sequence. It is left raising NotImplementedError. Nothing is pushed and there is no pull request yet.
